episodes.211347: An isolated thunderstorm produced brief large hail over Ingham County.
episodes.211356: A frontal boundary interacting with southerly flow produced a period of heavy rainfall across Puerto Rico from February 2 through February 4, 2026. Abundant moisture and an advective pattern supported widespread showers and periods of moderate to heavy rainfall across the region.||Significant rainfall amounts fell across portions of PR. These conditions resulted in urban and small-stream flooding, localized flash flooding, and minor landslides, particularly across the interior, southern, and western parts of Puerto Rico. Elevated streamflows were observed, with some rivers reaching action stage.

events.narrative: A landslide occurred along PR-123 in the Saltillo neighborhood of Adjuntas during the morning of February 2, 2026. Emergency managers reported that rainfall between 1 and 3 inches triggered slope failure, resulting in debris covering the roadway and downed trees in the area. The landslide disrupted traffic on the roadway and required clearing operations.
